name: public-api-reachable

finding.title: The fee estimate leaves the payout list out of a version 3 payload
finding.description: The new v3 arm sizes the payload without `p.payouts`, which `Payload::encode` now writes in place of `script` for version 3. `fee` prices the transaction from this estimate at the minimum relay rate, so a transaction carrying a v3 payload pays for fewer bytes than it has and relays reject it. The builder's own `new()` only creates v2 payloads, but `set_payload` is public and accepts any version.

checks: src/payload.rs:43 `3 => self.payouts.encode(w)?` writes the payout list for version 3
